metadata.description: Azure region for all resources.
Region for Azure SQL only. Some regions stop accepting new SQL servers (RegionDoesNotAllowProvisioning); the installer lets you pick another. Empty = location.
Short lowercase prefix used in resource names.
Installer record id (GUID). Stamped on every resource as valuelens-install-id.
Extra tags required by the customer's policy.
Container image registry and tag for the jobs and web images.
Optional resource ID of a private Azure Container Registry holding the images. The managed identity gets AcrPull on it and pulls with that identity. Empty = public registry.
Cron schedule (UTC) for the daily collect/process/publish run.
Steps the scheduled run executes, mirroring the Enable* switches of the Fabric pipeline.
Demo mode: the run job publishes the bundled synthetic sample instead of collecting tenant data (VALUELENS_SAMPLE_DATA).
Entra principal that administers SQL. Defaults to the managed identity so the migrate job can create database users.
Preserve-on-update: the installer reads the live values back and passes them in.
Private networking only: address space of the VNet (at least a /22).
Deploy the Analytics Hub web app (SPA + /api).
App registration (client) id of the Analytics Hub web app; empty until the installer creates it.
Identifier URI the web API exposes (api://<fqdn>/<clientId>); empty until the installer sets it.
Collection modules the run job executes (catalog ids), e.g. core,org,m365.
Audit history to backfill on the first run, in days.
Power BI workspace and semantic models (JSON: {"alias":{"workspaceId":"..","itemId":".."}}). Set by the installer after the models exist.
Display name of the SQL reader app registration that the migrate job grants db_datareader (the Power BI refresh credential).
Client (app) ID of the SQL reader app registration. The migrate job creates its database user by SID, so the SQL server needs no Graph access.
Credit consumption: subscription whose Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry costs the run job reads. Empty = Azure AI left out.
Credit consumption: other subscriptions (comma-separated) that Copilot pay-as-you-go billing policies charge.
Credit consumption, private networking: SharePoint site, drive and folder the Copilot Studio flow and the Viva export are dropped in. Empty = the storage account's landing container.

names.sqlServer: [if(empty(parameters('sqlLocation')), format('sql-{0}-{1}', parameters('namePrefix'), variables('suffix')), format('sql-{0}-{1}', parameters('namePrefix'), substring(uniqueString(resourceGroup().id, parameters('installId'), parameters('sqlLocation')), 0, 6)))]
names.environment: [if(variables('privateNetworking'), format('cae-{0}-{1}-vnet', parameters('namePrefix'), variables('suffix')), format('cae-{0}-{1}', parameters('namePrefix'), variables('suffix')))]

metadata.description: Subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments (private networking). Empty = no VNet.

variables.jobEnv: [concat(variables('commonEnv'), createArray(createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_MODULES', 'value', parameters('modules')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_AUDIT_HISTORY_DAYS', 'value', string(parameters('auditHistoryDays'))), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_SQL_READER_NAME', 'value', parameters('sqlReaderName')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_SQL_READER_CLIENT_ID', 'value', parameters('sqlReaderClientId')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_SAMPLE_DATA', 'value', if(parameters('sampleData'), 'true', 'false')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_AZURE_AI_SUBSCRIPTION', 'value', parameters('azureAiSubscriptionId')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_PAYG_SUBSCRIPTIONS', 'value', parameters('paygSubscriptionIds')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_DROP_SITE_ID', 'value', parameters('dropSiteId')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_DROP_DRIVE_ID', 'value', parameters('dropDriveId')), createObject('name', 'VALUELENS_DROP_FOLDER', 'value', parameters('dropFolder'))))]
